title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's)
description: Find the max sum of any contiguous subarray. Kadane's: at each index, either extend the running sum or restart from the current value.

notes: Initialize cur AND best to nums[0] — handles all-negative arrays correctly.
cur = max(nums[i], cur + nums[i]) is the heart: drop the prefix when it hurts.
Best is the max over all cur values seen, not the final cur.

questions.q: Why initialize both cur and best to nums[0] instead of 0?
options: So all-negative arrays return the largest (least negative) element

questions.q: The core recurrence cur = max(nums[i], cur + nums[i]) means:
options: Either extend the running sum or start a new subarray at i

questions.q: Why track best separately instead of returning cur?
options: cur can drop after hitting a peak; best holds the running maximum
questions.explain: After a peak, a string of negatives makes cur fall. best preserves the max seen.

blanks.hint: extend or restart — take the larger
compare against the latest running sum

L3.prompt: Write `maxSubArray(nums)` returning the max sum of any contiguous subarray. Log `maxSubArray([-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4])`.
hints: One pass. Two variables: running sum and best so far.
At each i, decide whether to extend the previous subarray or restart at nums[i].
